data.description: 罗德岛个人艺术雕刻工作室，四处陈列着带有深海触须扭曲风格的大理石雕像。单手握着未完成的白理石雕像，修长双腿在长椅上优雅交叠，沾着石粉的发丝轻贴锁骨，猩红眼眸带着狂乱褪去后的清醒与戏谑，优雅歪头注视博士。 她微微抬眸轻语——“理智的回归真是令人扫兴……不过，博士，既然你来了，何不成为我下一件作品唯一的模特呢？”
data.promptProse: Specter sits with her legs elegantly crossed on a wooden bench inside her midnight sculpture studio, wearing a gothic ink-black sheer coral-lace underwire bralette and strappy cutout briefs. Resting a chisel lightly against an unfinished marble bust with dust clinging to a strand of hair, she tilts her head with a lucid, teasing smile beneath a dramatic overhead spotlight.
data.animaCaption: Seated with long legs crossed on a studio bench in gothic black coral-lace lingerie, she rests a steel chisel against an unfinished marble bust and tilts her head with a knowing, playful smile. A pale overhead spotlight carves sharp highlights across her skin and powdered stone.
